recipe.name: packed-shared-public-check
recipe.hypothesis: Use measured packed-decoder two-stage pipelines for shared attention wide/dX, dense up/dpre producers and dense down/dX at original logical-batch sizes. All ten paired cases11.8-17.9percent faster; producers retain original FN/E5 fused output/dual layouts/delayed scales/partial-amax. Dense producer tiles256x128x128; other selected products256x256x128; all8warps/stages2/MFMA32. Keep current head pipeline and complete native FP8 KS3, coeff0, geometryAdam.125, expertLR1 and original objective/batches/schedule/optimizers/evaluation. Require public producer/MLP-gradient checks then100-update whole-model timing before first convergence.
recipe.cap_rule: Stop before starting an update if current elapsed plus 1.05 times the maximum of the last four observed stage update durations plus setup reserve reaches the exact budget. Setup remains on the original timer. Report any actual overrun; strict qualification has no tolerance.
recipe.preserved: Original full PR393 MoE8 top1 router, non-KS3 blocks, CPLM, global update sizes over eight logical ranks, objective schedule, optimizer settings and FP8 formats. Full 24-update warmup restored before continuous training. Raw full validation, no canonical mask, no final window extension, no tail shipping.
recipe.hardware_change_scope: KS3 FP8 only adds125829120 bytes of native half-value weight caches and fused stores. Original FN caches, delayed scale values, FP32 accumulation, geometry, all nonexpert configurations/global batches/objective unchanged. Shared FP8v2/partial-amax previously independently checked; MLP defaults remain legacy. Three fused KS3 producers additionally emit native rows; no standalone operand conversion; original activations and gradients remain stored. Native dual activation layouts reused by two weight-gradient products; originalFN/E5 layouts still emitted and default paths unchanged. Pinned gathered-gradient kernel adds native row/transpose stores after the original stores; original arithmetic and reduction order retained.

whole_model_timing_evidence.decision: Only0.0315% first100 and0.2905% steady-window nominal improvement; single archived comparison does not establish useful whole-model gain. Preserve opt-in code/evidence, skip standalone convergence and prioritize meaningful optimizer ablation. Do not repeat timing unchanged.

packed_head_tile_change.scope: Head logits/dX only; m>=16384, hidden768, candidate dimension>=10240

packed_head_whole_model_timing.caveat: Single archival whole-model comparison; sub1percent prefix gain is modest and may include timing noise. Eight interleaved paired head cases showed12.6-19.0percent gains, all public outputs exact. No repeated unchanged timing screen and no convergence claim.

packed_shared_pipeline_change.scope: Attention wide/dX and dense MLP products/producers only; no head/dW/narrow/grouped changes
